label: Dec 2025
title: AMI Labs founded in Paris
description: PengyouCo SAS — the legal entity behind AMI Labs — is incorporated in Paris with €10,000 share capital, registered at 51 rue de Seine, Paris 6e.

label: Dec 2025
title: Corporate structure formalised
description: Articles of association updated with early share restructuring: 1,000,000 shares divided into ordinary shares and SP preference shares carrying 10× voting rights.

label: Jan 2026
title: AMI Labs brand launched
description: PengyouCo rebrands as Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI Labs), unveiling its mission to build AI systems that go beyond language — grounded in the physical world.

label: Feb 2026
title: Yann LeCun joins as Executive Chairman
description: Turing Award laureate and former Meta Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun co-founds AMI Labs, bringing his vision for World Models and next-generation machine intelligence.

label: Mar 2026
title: $1.03B seed round at $3.5B valuation
description: AMI Labs closes a landmark $1.03 billion seed round — one of the largest in AI history — backed by Jeff Bezos, Bezos Expeditions, NVIDIA, Samsung, Eric Schmidt, and 60+ investors.

label: Mar 2026
title: Global hiring accelerates
description: AMI Labs begins scaling its team across Paris, New York, Montreal, and Singapore — recruiting world-class researchers, engineers, and operators to build World Models.
